options.text: The model reads media such as images or audio, not only text.
options.explanation: Right. You give it an image or a sound, and it answers in text.

options.text: The model makes images, video and audio at once.
options.explanation: That is about outputs. Multimodal input is about what the model can read.

options.text: You type the prompt in several languages.
options.explanation: Languages are not modalities. Modalities are text, image, video and audio.

questions.prompt: You send an animated GIF to Claude. What does it see?

options.explanation: Claude's docs say animations are not supported.
Right. Claude uses only the first frame of an animation.

questions.prompt: A client asks you to use a vision model to prove an influencer's photo is AI-generated. What do you say?

options.text: Sure, AI models are the best fake detectors.
options.explanation: Claude's docs say it cannot determine whether an image is AI-generated and might be wrong if asked.

options.text: Claude's docs say it can't tell if an image is AI-generated. Don't use a model's answer as proof.
options.explanation: Right. Use other evidence, not the model's guess.

options.text: Only if you send the photo at 4K.
